text:
maria_cs: Quick capture from three onboarding calls today. repeating asks so we can triage: per-route billing clarity, opt-out for continuous batching on latency-sensitive routes, and route-level embedding model pin.

maria_cs: Acme and NorthBay called out invoice surprises; Acme renewal in ~6 weeks and they flagged cost mapping as blocker.

sam_pm: Need to estimate effort/impact. who can spike the batching opt-out?

anya_eng: I can do a small runtime change to check route config before batching. low risk but we should default to batching on to avoid throughput regressions. estimate: 1 sprint + rollout telemetry.

devin_sre: We already emit tokens and batching flag per request. per-route billing dashboard is analytics+UI work 1-2 sprints for MVP export.

maria_cs: Customer quote to preserve: "We see random high charges and can't trace them to behavior." Also "Batching ruins our chat latency."

triage-bot: @maria_cs created ticket CS-1588: "Acct clarity + batching opt-out" labeled renewal-risk.

sam_pm: Prioritization: 1) batching opt-out (fast, may save renewals) 2) per-route billing export (mid) 3) embedding-pin per route (long). agreed?

maria_cs: Agreed. I'll ask renewals to join the next Acme check-in if we can show a timeline.

anya_eng: I'll draft a spike plan for the opt-out and include telemetry to compare batched vs unbatched tail latency.

devin_sre: I'll export 14 days of traces for acme-org (tokens, batching flag, latency_ms, route). will drop link when ready.

maria_cs: Thanks team - I'll post meeting notes after sync.
